name: Rei Ayanami - Angel of Sex
source:
Fan made game done with Blade Engine.
It’s based upon Neon Genesis Evangelion. Story concentrates at Rei – after death of the previous Rei, new clone is ready to use. What’s gonna happened to her? Will she become sex toy of her perverted teacher, unwilling actress of the porn movies or maybe excellent EVA pilot? Everything is in your hands. Remember, Rei depends on you!
translation:
粉丝用Blade Engine制作游戏。
它基于新世纪福音战士。故事集中在丽——上一个丽死后，新的克隆人就可以使用了。她会发生什么事？她会成为她变态老师的性玩具，不情愿的色情电影女演员，还是优秀的EVA飞行员？一切都在你的手中。请记住，丽取决于你！
